summary: Migrated the B108 single-snapshot MCP launch-routing curriculum (29 rows) to a 251-row curriculum sampled from the FULL live historical auto-pickup/review-queue outcome distribution (3105 task cards read from machine_task_cards_v1.jsonl at build time, status_counts={'pending': 12, 'processing': 2, 'review': 19, 'blocked_data': 10, 'blocked_review_failed': 13, 'future_backlog': 2, 'blocked': 2, 'finished': 2988, 'completed': 44, 'stale_already_done': 13}). Adds a historical_review_outcome feature axis (in_progress/in_review/completed_ok/review_outcome_failed_historical/blocked_*_historical) that B108 did not have, plus real-active-claim collision rows and synthetic wrong-runner/topic mismatch rows as new abstain classes. B108's 29 rows are carried forward unmodified (labels/safety) with feature_axes attached for regression continuity. Static allowlists remain the deterministic safety floor and are not replaced by any of this -- every row's safety section sets static_allowlist_is_safety_floor_not_replaced=True.

data_source.read_method: plain open()/json.loads per line, malformed lines skipped
data_source.concurrency_note: This file is live and mutated by other topic-bound workers during this build; row COUNTS are a function of live queue state and will differ between build runs. Structural/schema gates below do not depend on exact counts.

historical_review_outcome_note: blocked_review_failed / blocked_data / blocked cards are emitted as is_positive=True (abstain=False) rows: their adapter/runner/topic assignment was a real, structurally-valid routing decision -- what later failed was the task's SUBSTANTIVE outcome (review content rejected, data missing), not the routing choice itself. That distinction is recorded on feature_axes.historical_review_outcome, not on the abstain label, to avoid teaching the router to abstain on topics/runners merely because some past task on that pairing failed review for unrelated content reasons.
neural_bridge_note: These curriculum rows are TRAINING TARGETS for a learned neural router that selects adapter/runner/topic from task context and abstains when evidence is insufficient (collision, wrong pairing, ambiguous topic, non-trainable mode). adapter_of() and the historical-status/outcome bucketing in this build script are curriculum LABEL GENERATORS only -- NOT runtime launch authority. Production routing must be the neural model's learned dispatch over rows like these, never a regex/keyword cue router promoted to active_default. Deterministic safety gates (COMMAND_ALLOWLIST, LAUNCHABLE_BINARIES, the dual AIWORKHUB_ALLOW_LAUNCH/ALLOW_WRITES env-gate contract) remain the safety floor after the neural router selects; this task neither touches nor weakens them.

context7_usage.reason: Pure repo-local curriculum/data-curation build over this repo's own task-card store and prior curriculum artifact; no external library/API/SDK question was open.
